raw_problem.problem_text:
对于无限深势阱中运动的粒子（见图 3-1）证明

$$
\bar {x} = \frac {a}{2} \quad \overline {{(x - \bar {x}) ^ {2}}} = \frac {a ^ {2}}{1 2} \left(1 - \frac {6}{n ^ {2} \pi^ {2}}\right)
$$

并证明当 $n \to \infty$ 时上述结果与经典结论一致。

![](images/0ba049edd1f99e04b8f63ace2f75e031a978795cd7e37f99437bf43f47f07d58.jpg)
raw_problem.solution_text:
写出归一化波函数：

$$
\Psi_ {n} (x) = \sqrt {\frac {2}{a}} \sin \frac {n \pi x}{a} \tag {1}
$$

先计算坐标平均值：

$$
\bar {x} = \int_ {0} ^ {a} \left| \Psi \right| ^ {2} x d x = \int_ {0} ^ {a} \frac {2}{a} \sin^ {2} \frac {n \pi x}{a} x d x = \frac {1}{a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} (1 - \cos \frac {2 n \pi x}{a}) x d x
$$

利用公式：

$$
\int x \sin p x d x = - \frac {x \cos p x}{p} + \frac {\sin p x}{p ^ {2}} \tag {2}
$$

得 sin coscos pxx px x pxdx     $\int x \cos p x d x = - { \frac { x \sin p x } { p } } + { \frac { \cos p x } { p ^ { 2 } } }$ （3）2p

$$
\bar {x} = \frac {1}{a} \left| \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} - \left(\frac {a}{2 n \pi}\right) x \sin \frac {2 n \pi x}{a} - \left(\frac {a}{2 n \pi}\right) ^ {2} \cos \frac {2 n \pi x}{a} \right| _ {0} ^ {a} = \frac {a}{2}
$$

计算均方根值用 ${ \overline { { ( x - { \overline { { x } } } ) ^ { 2 } } } } = { \overline { { x ^ { 2 } } } } - { \overline { { ( x } } ) ^ { 2 } } , { \overline { { x } } }$ 以知，可计算 $x ^ { 2 }$

$$
\overline {{x ^ {2}}} = \int_ {0} ^ {a} | \Psi | ^ {2} x ^ {2} d x = \int \frac {2}{a} x ^ {2} \sin^ {2} \frac {n \pi x}{a} d x = \frac {1}{a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} x ^ {2} (1 - \cos \frac {2 n \pi x}{a}) d x
$$

利用公式 $\int x ^ { 2 } \cos p x d x = { \frac { 1 } { p } } x ^ { 2 } \sin p x + { \frac { 2 } { p ^ { 2 } } } x \cos p x - { \frac { 1 } { p ^ { 3 } } } \sin p x$ （5）p 2 p 3

$$
\overline {{x ^ {2}}} = \frac {1}{a} \left| \frac {1}{3} x ^ {2} - \left[ \frac {a}{2 n \pi} x ^ {2} - \left(\frac {a}{2 n \pi}\right) ^ {2} \right] \sin \frac {2 n \pi x}{a} - \left(\frac {a}{2 n \pi}\right) ^ {2} \cdot 2 x \cos \frac {2 n \pi x}{a} \right| _ {0} ^ {a}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} = \frac {a ^ {2}}{3} - \frac {a ^ {2}}{2 n ^ {2} \pi^ {2}} \\ \overline {{(x - \bar {x}) ^ {2}}} = \overline {{x ^ {2}}} - (\bar {x}) ^ {2} = \frac {a ^ {2}}{3} - \frac {a ^ {2}}{2 n ^ {2} \pi^ {2}} - \left(\frac {a}{2}\right) ^ {2} \\ = \frac {a ^ {2}}{1 2} - \frac {a ^ {2}}{2 n ^ {2} \pi^ {2}} \tag {6} \\ \end{array}
$$

在经典力学的一维无限深势阱问题中，因粒子局限在（0，a）范围中运动，各点的几率密度看作相同，由于总几率是 1，几率密度 $\omega = { \frac { 1 } { a } }$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \bar {x} = \int_ {0} ^ {a} \omega x d x = \int_ {0} ^ {a} \frac {1}{a} x d x = \frac {a}{2} \\ \overline {{x}} ^ {2} = \int_ {0} ^ {a} \frac {1}{a} x ^ {2} d x = \frac {a ^ {2}}{3} \\ \overline {{(x - \bar {x}) ^ {2}}} = \overline {{x ^ {2}}} - (\bar {x}) ^ {2} = \frac {a ^ {2}}{3} - \frac {a ^ {2}}{2 n ^ {2} \pi^ {2}} - \left(\frac {a}{2}\right) ^ {2} \\ \end{array}
$$

故当 $n \to \infty$ 时二者相一致。
